honesty_note: The open-arena outcomes and H2-v1 high-resolution LOCO failure were known before H3. This policy provides internal development model comparison only, not independent validation.
scope: DCM-control 20 cm versus 100 cm approach only

baseline_turn_concentration.definition: von Mises concentration for turn angle conditional on a reorientation; shared across treatments and unaffected by G

entry_orientation_retention_q.rule: Same q in 20 cm and 100 cm conditions; it may not depend on treatment.

entry_transition_model.definition: With probability q preserve the protocol-sampled post-transition heading; otherwise draw heading uniformly on [-pi, pi).
entry_transition_model.H1_boundary: Treatment-specific entry-heading distributions remain forbidden. Allowing them would evaluate H1, not H3.

objective.continuous_distance: quantile Wasserstein-1 divided by pooled training SD
objective.aggregation: equal-weight mean squared component distance across both path treatments
objective.compatibility_rule: Use the same objective and threshold-independent reference rows as H2 so held-out loss comparisons remain interpretable.

nested_models.H3_null: Estimate ell0, kappa_turn, and q with the history gate disabled (rho_gate=0).
nested_models.H3_context: Estimate ell0, kappa_turn, q, lambda_history, tau_gate, and rho_gate.

cross_validation.comparison: Fit both models on five colonies and score on the sixth with a separate evaluation seed stream.
cross_validation.promotion_guard: The history-dependent H3_context must improve held-out loss over H3_null in at least 5 of 6 folds and show positive median held-out improvement.
cross_validation.H2_comparison_guard: To call H3 development-preferred over H2-v1, H3_context must also have lower held-out loss than the recorded H2-v1 candidate in at least 4 of 6 matching colony folds and positive median relative improvement versus H2-v1.

identifiability.rule: If lambda_history and rho_gate form a broad ridge while M200/M1000 are stable, report the effective multipliers/mean-free-paths rather than false point identification.
identifiability.boundary_warning: Parameters repeatedly selected at search bounds are not considered identified.

structural_negative_controls: No direct speed modulation is permitted.
Turn-angle distribution conditional on a reorientation must be identical across short and long histories.
No direct centerline attraction or exit-edge targeting is permitted.
raw_trajectory_tests_if_data_recovered: reorientation count by early/late time window
hazard decay with time since entry
holdout_rule: The Y-maze remains completely inaccessible to fitting, candidate ranking, stopping rules, and model selection.
canonical_model_rule: H3 estimation tools may write reports only. Even a passed internal promotion guard creates at most a development-preferred candidate; it does not automatically modify the canonical ant model.
